title: Fall in Love All Over Again: 'Love Village' Is Back for Season 3, Premieres October 6
summary: Love Village Embraces Adults with Woulds and Regrets: Love Village S3 will be streaming on Netflix on October 9.
body_markdown:
Netflix will premiere the reality series


[Love Village](https://www.netflix.com/LoveVillage) Season 3 starting October 6, releasing every Tuesday over five weeks for a total of 23 episodes — with Episodes 1 through 8 dropping all at once on the first day.


This romantic reality series sees men and women aged 35 to 60 move in together into a vintage house in Love Village in search of one last shot at love. Seasons 1 and 2 became a viral sensation as an unprecedented, raw and deeply realistic dating show.


The newly released trailer introduces the new Love Village at the foot of Mount Fuji, where residents live a semi-self-sufficient life together in a spacious, open setting built around a slower-paced lifestyle, renovating a red vintage house by hand.


Away from the hustle and bustle of the city, sharing meals and sleeping under one roof, they talk about the paths they have walked. While they sometimes clash, they gradually open up to each other's genuine feelings. Behind bright personalities and free spirits lie divorces, bereavements, and sudden illnesses. Wounds and regrets that aren't easy to share slowly find their way into words. Shedding their armor and exposing their true selves, these adults attempt to trust and love someone once again in the rest of their lives — shining a light on each of their fresh starts.


The theme song is The Police's timeless "Every Breath You Take", which envelopes the village and its residents as they face love, passion, and life directly in every moment. Will they find true love and leave the Love Village as a couple?


The ring of that iconic pink bell will echo across the grand landscape. These clumsy adults' nerve-wracking, heart-pounding romantic journeys are impossible to look away from. Witness the miracles in


Love Village


history alongside emcees Atsushi Tamura and Becky.


Love Village


Season 3 premieres October 6, only on Netflix.
